comparison.objective: Open a latched egg carton and transfer six eggs safely into a basket.
comparison.physical_skill: Brace-and-open manipulation followed by repeated fragile-object extraction and transport, not impact-controlled fracture.
comparison.success_condition: All six eggs reach the basket; an egg falling more than 3 cm is broken and invalid.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual stabilization and repeated small-part recovery, but eggs are pre-existing cargo rather than fragments created by a calibrated strike. No spec versions or final stability thresholds are supplied.
